Title: Methodistiaeth Cymru: sef hanes blaenorol a gwedd bresenol y Methodistiaid Calfinaidd yn Nghymru, o ddechreuad y cyfundeb hyd y flwyddyn 1850; Cyfrol I
Creator: John Hughes, Liverpool (1775-1854, per the host)
Publisher: Gwrecsam (Wrexham): cyhoeddwyd gan R. Hughes a'i Fab, Heol-yr-Eglwys
Publication Date: 1851 (the host's date; the title-page numeral is garbled in the scan)
Rights: Public Domain (published 1851, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item's own rights statement reads 'NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT')
Language: cym
Source: Internet Archive item methodistiaethcy01hughuoft (https://archive.org/details/methodistiaethcy01hughuoft), the item's own methodistiaethcy01hughuoft_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: Robarts - University of Toronto; host metadata date: 1851. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: cc6495456bcd23487540b03370dc9629224188a9f8e486720a3b52129534b21b.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. University of Toronto (Robarts) scan; clean OCR of a Welsh printing.
Content note: The first volume of the Welsh Calvinistic Methodists' own history of their movement, written by one of its ministers: the beginnings under Harris and Rowland, the first associations, with the minutes of the Watford association of 1743-1744 and other early documents in Welsh, and county-by-county accounts of the societies and their members.
